name: Sister ~Daraku no Kokuin~
source:
Alfred and Miria are brother and sister who want to protect the church left by their father. Corrupt clergyman Rodrigo arrive one day and takes steps to compromise Alfred. The siblings' life soon turn in a lustful abyss.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
阿爾弗雷德與米莉亞兄妹想守護父親留下的教堂。一天，腐化的教士羅德里戈到來，並一步步誘使阿爾弗雷德墮落。兄妹倆的生活很快墜入慾望的深淵。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
